description: This file defines the BlockReferenceExpression class, which represents a block call node within the Twig templating engine's AST. It includes methods for compiling block references into executable PHP code.

classes.name:
Twig

ode lockreferenceexpression
classes.description: Represents a block call node within the Twig template engine, responsible for rendering or checking block presence in a template.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a BlockReferenceExpression with a node representing the block name, an optional template node, and the line number.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the block reference into executable PHP code, generating different code depending on whether it's a fallback for 'is_defined_test' or 'output' flags.

methods.name: compileTemplateCall
methods.description: Helper method to generate code that calls a specific method on the template, such as 'hasBlock', 'yieldBlock', or 'renderBlock'.

methods.name: compileBlockArguments
methods.description: Prepares the arguments for the block call, including the block name, context, and possibly the blocks array.
